featured_reviews.review_text:
A broker with multiple case at police station for fraud.
He makes a deal with the property owner to deduct security money which was supposed to returned to the tenant.

The deducted amount has his share of %.

He takes advantage of tenants situation for getting money from tenants.
How he does this?
He gets you a house for rent, deal is done at 75k rent per month.

As soon as tenant has left his old house and reaches to the new rented apartment building, jeetu takes advantage of you time and ask you for whole rent exactly at that time and threatens you not to give the keys.

Now since you are on road and no place to go, he takes advantage of this situation to extract money from tenants.

He will take this money on someone else’s account so there is no proof that tenant has given him the brokerage.
Probably he is not a RERA registered broker, to avoid getting complaints against him he will ask you to send money on his friends or relatives accounts.

After that, when you tenure is over and you decide to leave the house he and the owner will of a sudden come up with multiple reasons and charge so that they do not have to pay back the security deposit and jeetu has his share of % already decided with owner in this.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Shoeb Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an extremely disappointing experience with this broker agency. From the very beginning, there was a complete lack of transparency and professionalism. Important details were either hidden or only revealed at the last minute, which created unnecessary stress and confusion.

Communication was poor throughout — calls and messages were ignored or delayed, and whenever I did get a response, it felt vague and unhelpful. It honestly seemed like once they secured their commission, client satisfaction was no longer a priority.

On top of that, there were unexpected charges that were never clearly explained upfront. This felt misleading and unethical. A broker’s job is to make the process smoother, but in my case, they made it far more frustrating and time-consuming.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before engaging with this agency. Make sure everything is documented clearly, and don’t rely solely on verbal commitments. Unfortunately, I would not recommend their services based on my experience.
